I couldn't do any research for Proverbs 30. My first attempt to fetch the source pages was blocked: the tool said I had no code-execution calls left, and that's the only route I have to the web. So I have no commentary on any verse yet.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, with a URL for every point. Writing notes from memory would break both rules, so I haven't.

If you start a new session or ask again, I'll begin with these pages. I couldn't open them, so I can't confirm the addresses are correct:
- **Traditional reading:**
  - Enduring Word (enduringword.com/bible-commentary/proverbs-30/)
  - Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary on biblehub.com (biblehub.com/commentaries/[ellicott|gill|pulpit]/proverbs/30.htm)
  - preceptaustin.org
- **Where Protestant traditions differ:**
  - Wesley's notes (wesley.nnu.edu), for the Methodist reading
  - Ligonier, Desiring God and Got Questions on v. 4 (the name of His Son) and vv. 5–6 (Scripture's sufficiency)
- **Other views:**
  - NET Bible notes (netbible.org) on who Agur and Ithiel are, how to read v. 1 in the Hebrew, and the number sayings in vv. 15–31
  - Catholic and Orthodox readings on v. 4 as a hint of the Son
  - Pages that respond to prosperity teaching using vv. 8–9 ("neither poverty nor riches")
